event.conference: CVPath workshop at WACV 2027; participation opened in 2026

eligibility_review.status_at_cutoff: Participation open or already under way; final outcomes not established in this review
eligibility_review.rationale: Algorithm outputs include per-case explanations in addition to recurrence predictions. This meets explicit reasoning as operationally defined here; an optional text form does not independently establish a vision-language or report-generation objective. Permitted foundation encoders do not establish a foundation-model benchmark objective.
eligibility_review.evidence: Workshop page documents registration/starter-kit opening on 22 August 2026. Predictions include recurrence time, a derived risk category, attribution map and per-case interpretability report. Evaluation specifies perturbation faithfulness, AI and pathology panels, and external validation. Expert/output results were not established by the cutoff.
eligibility_review.limitation: Workshop and platform timelines differ on the October testing milestones; the platform separately schedules external validation for February 2027 and contains a workshop-year typo. No scheduled phase is coded as executed. A method manuscript is distinct from the algorithm-produced per-case interpretation. WACV 2027 affiliation is retained separately from the analytical year.

assessment_evidence.scope: Timetables and open phases do not establish assessment execution.
assessment_evidence.qualification: False flags mean evidence not established by the cutoff, not proof of non-execution; external validation is scheduled for February 2027.

provenance.review_method: Source-linked supplementary documentary review; prior-period start dates checked retrospectively.
